subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should the fix for the stale orphaned prompt root issue drop selected internal inter-session leaves by sourceTool as this PR proposes, or should maintainers prefer the broader session-repair strategy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759?
rationale: Both PRs target the same user-visible issue but choose different session-state semantics, and automated review cannot choose the permanent repair contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Prefer the broader session-repair PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the canonical fix if maintainers want orphan repair to preserve older user text as marked context and remove it from active history before provider submission.

options.title: Adopt this sourceTool drop strategy
options.body: Continue this PR if maintainers want internal inter-session completion/announcement leaves removed whenever a fresh prompt is present, after real embedded-agent proof is supplied.

options.title: Ask for a narrower combined repair
options.body: Request a new or revised PR if maintainers want the metadata-skipping repair plus an explicit sourceTool drop rule for internal handoffs.

recommendation.title: Prefer the broader session-repair PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the canonical fix if maintainers want orphan repair to preserve older user text as marked context and remove it from active history before provider submission.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the queued orphan prompt preservation behavior and is the strongest feature-history owner for choosing how that repair contract should evolve.
